mapper.insert: INSERT INTO enrollments(student_id, course_id, status, enrollment_source) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, 'active', #{enrollmentSource}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status = VALUES(status), enrollment_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY c.vindex DESC, c.course_id DESC

SELECT c.*, e.enrollment_id, e.enrollment_source, e.enrollment_date, e.status as enrollment_status FROM enrollments e JOIN courses c ON c.course_id = e.course_id WHERE e.student_id = #{studentId} AND e.status = 'active' ORDER BY e.enrollment_date DESC
SELECT s.* FROM enrollments e JOIN students s ON s.id = e.student_id WHERE e.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY s.id DESC
